articles.title: India-US trade talks hit ‘plateau’
articles.summary: India and the US have reached a challenging stage in their trade negotiations, according to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. She indicated that both nations must navigate a significant trade imbalance affecting their discussions.

articles.title: Rupee hovers near 96 as oil stays above $100 per barrel, foreign selling persists
articles.summary: The rupee started off on a weaker note against the US dollar due to soaring crude oil prices and foreign investors selling off. In response, the Reserve Bank of India is stepping in to curb volatile changes, as forex reserves dwindle.

articles.title: Canada ‘looking forward’ to seal trade deal with India as fifth CEPA round begins
articles.summary: India and Canada are gearing up for the fifth session of negotiations on the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, which will take place in Ottawa.

articles.title: Man sells ancestral land for Rs 8 cr, claims LTCG exemption; gets notice with Rs 6.36 cr additions
articles.summary: In the tax return that he filed, the man declared LTCG of Rs 7.73 crore after accounting for certain expenses. He claimed tax exemptions of Rs 2.64 crore under Section 54F, which relates to residential property, and Section 54B, applicable to agricultural property.

articles.title: Nikkei jumps 2.5% above 70,000 to three-month high as AI stocks rally
articles.summary: Japan's Nikkei index experienced a remarkable rise of over 2% on Monday, breaking the 70,000 mark for the first time in three months. The surge was largely driven by chip manufacturers like Tokyo Electron and Advantest, while Kioxia's contribution fell short.

articles.summary: EY India chairman Rajiv Memani emphasized the importance of expediting GST refunds and addressing input tax credit issues. He suggested allowing companies to claim expenses related to travel and insurance as eligible credits.

articles.title: Credit offtake stays ahead of banks' deposit growth
articles.summary: In the second quarter of FY27, advances at several banks grew significantly faster than deposit growth. Smaller banks, such as Tamilnad Mercantile Bank and Karnataka Bank, recorded impressive credit expansions.

articles.title: Anup Bagchi's Act 1: Set HDFC house in order
articles.summary: Anup Bagchi has been chosen as the new CEO of HDFC Bank after Sashidhar Jagdishan's decision not to continue. Bagchi's leadership will address critical issues within the bank, including leadership succession and regulatory concerns.

articles.title: RBI may end rate-cut cycle with first hike since February 2023
articles.summary: Bankers expect the Reserve Bank of India to raise the repo rate by 25 basis points soon. This marks the end of the rate-cutting phase that began in February 2025. Economists predict inflation will exceed the RBI’s forecasts, necessitating tightening.

articles.title: India in striking distance of 8% growth, says Shaktikanta Das
articles.summary: India is expected to achieve close to 8% economic growth, aided by recent reforms and increased investment. The resilience of the economy is attributed to strategies implemented over the past decade and strong domestic demand.

articles.summary: Global refining capacity is set to expand significantly over the next five years, with new projects concentrated in Asia and Africa. The shift could alter regional fuel trade flows as some markets add capacity while others face refinery closures.

articles.title: Faster registration, easier refunds: Reform rollout with GST 2.0
articles.summary: GST Council plans to unveil substantial reforms aimed at improving business processes and facilitating growth. The proposed changes involve streamlined registration, easier refunds, and a more efficient input tax credit system.

articles.title: GST Council meeting on October 7: Arrest powers, ITC, prosecution threshold proposals on agenda - report
articles.summary: The GST Council will meet on October 7 to discuss major reforms in GST processes and enforcement. Proposed changes include removing tax officers' arrest powers and requiring judicial consent for any arrests.
